dc:description: One Research-doctorate destination dimension × group × specification, carrying the paired connection proportions and their saved difference.
dc:title: Destination connection
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: values: connected_percent: connected_pct; no_identified_connection_percent: no_identified_connection_pct; difference_pp: difference_pp; paired_counts: connected_likely_n; connected_observed_n; connected_unscored_n; no_identified_connection_likely_n; no_identified_connection_observed_n; no_identified_connection_unscored_n; sparse_flag: sparse_group_n_under_10; pvalues: fisher_two_sided_p; holm_p_within_dimension_spec
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
